en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a prominent church and a girls' school (Flickskolan) by a pond or river, with a well-kept park in the foreground. The tall central spire of the church dominates the cityscape. The image includes the printed Swedish text 'Kyrkan och Flickskolan.' and 'Sundsvall.' The reverse side contains a handwritten letter in Swedish and an address to Astrid Rhedin in Göteborg.
